name: GACM Technologies Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1995, GACM Technologies Ltd provides financial consultancy and financial technology-related services[1]
keyPoints:
Change in Business Line:[1]
Company used to be in the capital market business. On August 11th 2022, Securities Appellate Tribunal allowed actions of exchanges expelling the Company from the membership of exchange, and thus Stock Broking business of the Company was discontinued. On January 23rd 2023, company resolved to approve alteration in the Object Clause of the Company to catering to services in more diversified fields of businesses. Company approved the said alteration via Special Resolution passed on April 20, 2023

pros: Stock is trading at 0.58 times its book value
Company is expected to give good quarter
Company has delivered good profit growth of 19.7% CAGR over last 5 years
cons: Promoter holding has decreased over last quarter: -6.48%
Company has high debtors of 429 days.
Working capital days have increased from 259 days to 393 days
